logline: A 1978 Delhi manhunt following the disappearance and murder of schoolchildren, tracing a relentless investigator and the disturbing psychology of the men behind the crime.

renewal.note: Season 1 premiered June 12, 2026. No renewal announcement at time of seeding.

seasons.review_body: Raakh premiered on Amazon Prime Video on June 12, 2026, directed and executive-produced by Prosit Roy (Paatal Lok), and created by Anusha Nandakumar and Sandeep Saket. The series is set in 1978 Delhi and follows a police investigation into the disappearance and murder of school students, with Ali Fazal leading as the investigator and Sonali Bendre and Aamir Bashir in key supporting roles. Pre-release trade coverage positioned it as a psychologically layered crime procedural with a period setting, promising moral ambiguity and a slow-burn manhunt.
